categories.name: .NET
categories.description: Code-quality and dependency-hygiene tools for .NET projects.

categories.name: Workspace
categories.description: Repository-level tools independent of any specific language.

tools.name: analyze_csharp_code_style
tools.description: Analyzes a C# source file for coding style, member ordering, naming conventions, async/await patterns, and nullable safety.

tools.name: analyze_csharp_project_structure
tools.description: Checks a C# source file for project-structure rules: file-scoped namespaces, one type per file, file name matching the declared type, and no suppressed warnings.

tools.name: analyze_csharp_testing_style
tools.description: Checks a C# test file for test conventions: class and method naming, no XML doc comments, multi-assertion grouping, no ConfigureAwait, and namespace conformance.

tools.name: analyze_nuget_references
tools.description: Analyzes a project file's NuGet package references for hygiene issues such as duplicates, floating or wildcard versions, and missing version attributes.

tools.name: analyze_git_commit_message
tools.description: Validates a Git commit message against project conventions for both format and content.

tools.name: read_editorconfig_rules
tools.description: Resolves the effective .editorconfig properties that apply to a specific file.

tools.name: analyze_typescript_code_style
tools.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file for coding-style anti-patterns.
